record.reason: Patch-level training aggregates multiple tokens to cut LLM pretraining cost to about half, then uses token-level training to align inference behavior. It is explicitly a training-cost method and introduces no inference-time efficiency improvement.
record.title: Beyond Next Token Prediction: Patch-Level Training for Large Language Models
